```{r}
# ============================================================
# Variable Selection Simulation Study
# BIOS 6624 - Spring 2026
# [Your Name]
# ============================================================

# ============================================================
# SECTION 1: SETUP
# ============================================================

library(MASS)
library(glmnet)

set.seed(6624)

# --- Simulation parameters ---
n_sim        <- 50
sample_sizes <- c(250, 500)
rho_values   <- c(0, 0.35, 0.7)
p            <- 20
true_idx     <- 1:5
null_idx     <- 6:20
true_betas   <- c(0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5) / 3
all_betas    <- c(true_betas, rep(0, 15))

method_names <- c("Backward_F", "AIC", "BIC",
                   "Lasso_min", "Lasso_1se",
                   "ENet_min", "ENet_1se")
n_methods    <- length(method_names)

# ============================================================
# SECTION 2: HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================

# --- 2a. Data generation ---
generate_data <- function(n, p, betas, rho) {
  Sigma <- matrix(rho, nrow = p, ncol = p)
  diag(Sigma) <- 1
  X   <- mvrnorm(n = n, mu = rep(0, p), Sigma = Sigma)
  colnames(X) <- paste0("X", 1:p)
  eps <- rnorm(n)
  Y   <- X %*% betas + eps
  dat <- data.frame(Y = as.numeric(Y), X)
  return(dat)
}

# --- 2b. Backward elimination by F-test ---
backward_f_select <- function(dat, alpha = 0.05) {
  current_vars <- paste0("X", 1:20)

  repeat {
    if (length(current_vars) == 0) break

    fmla <- as.formula(paste("Y ~", paste(current_vars, collapse = " + ")))
    fit  <- lm(fmla, data = dat)
    pvals <- summary(fit)$coefficients[-1, 4]

    max_p   <- max(pvals)
    if (max_p > alpha) {
      drop_var     <- names(which.max(pvals))
      current_vars <- setdiff(current_vars, drop_var)
    } else {
      break
    }
  }

  selected <- paste0("X", 1:20) %in% current_vars
  names(selected) <- paste0("X", 1:20)
  return(selected)
}

# --- 2c. AIC-based backward selection ---
aic_select <- function(dat) {
  full    <- lm(Y ~ ., data = dat)
  reduced <- step(full, direction = "backward", k = 2, trace = 0)
  selected_names <- names(coef(reduced))[-1]
  selected <- paste0("X", 1:20) %in% selected_names
  names(selected) <- paste0("X", 1:20)
  return(selected)
}

# --- 2d. BIC-based backward selection ---
bic_select <- function(dat) {
  n       <- nrow(dat)
  full    <- lm(Y ~ ., data = dat)
  reduced <- step(full, direction = "backward", k = log(n), trace = 0)
  selected_names <- names(coef(reduced))[-1]
  selected <- paste0("X", 1:20) %in% selected_names
  names(selected) <- paste0("X", 1:20)
  return(selected)
}

# --- 2e. Penalized regression (lasso or elastic net) ---
penalized_select <- function(X_mat, Y_vec, alpha_val, lambda_rule) {
  cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(X_mat, Y_vec, alpha = alpha_val, nfolds = 10)

  if (lambda_rule == "min") {
    lambda_use <- cv_fit$lambda.min
  } else {
    lambda_use <- cv_fit$lambda.1se
  }

  coefs    <- as.numeric(coef(cv_fit, s = lambda_use))[-1]
  selected <- (coefs != 0)
  names(selected) <- paste0("X", 1:20)
  return(selected)
}

# --- 2f. Refit OLS on selected variables and extract inference ---
#     Returns beta_hat (length p, 0 if not selected),
#             ci_lower, ci_upper (NA if not selected),
#             pvals (NA if not selected)
refit_ols <- function(dat, selected) {
  var_names <- paste0("X", 1:20)
  beta_hat  <- rep(0, 20)
  ci_lower  <- rep(NA_real_, 20)
  ci_upper  <- rep(NA_real_, 20)
  pvals     <- rep(NA_real_, 20)
  names(beta_hat) <- names(ci_lower) <- names(ci_upper) <- names(pvals) <- var_names

  sel_vars <- var_names[selected]

  if (length(sel_vars) == 0) {
    return(list(beta_hat = beta_hat,
                ci_lower = ci_lower,
                ci_upper = ci_upper,
                pvals    = pvals))
  }

  fmla <- as.formula(paste("Y ~", paste(sel_vars, collapse = " + ")))
  fit  <- lm(fmla, data = dat)

  coefs <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  ci    <- confint(fit, level = 0.95)

  for (v in sel_vars) {
    beta_hat[v] <- coefs[v, 1]
    pvals[v]    <- coefs[v, 4]
    ci_lower[v] <- ci[v, 1]
    ci_upper[v] <- ci[v, 2]
  }

  return(list(beta_hat = beta_hat,
              ci_lower = ci_lower,
              ci_upper = ci_upper,
              pvals    = pvals))
}

# ============================================================
# SECTION 3: MAIN SIMULATION LOOP
# ============================================================

# --- Storage list: one entry per scenario ---
results_all <- list()

scenario_id <- 0

for (N in sample_sizes) {
  for (rho in rho_values) {

    scenario_id   <- scenario_id + 1
    scenario_name <- paste0("N", N, "_rho", rho)
    message("Starting scenario: ", scenario_name)

    # --- Initialize arrays for this scenario ---
    # Naive approach: selection + refit on full data
    selected_arr <- array(FALSE, dim = c(n_sim, p, n_methods),
                          dimnames = list(NULL, paste0("X", 1:p), method_names))
    beta_hat_arr <- array(0,     dim = c(n_sim, p, n_methods),
                          dimnames = list(NULL, paste0("X", 1:p), method_names))
    ci_lower_arr <- array(NA_real_, dim = c(n_sim, p, n_methods),
                          dimnames = list(NULL, paste0("X", 1:p), method_names))
    ci_upper_arr <- array(NA_real_, dim = c(n_sim, p, n_methods),
                          dimnames = list(NULL, paste0("X", 1:p), method_names))
    pval_arr     <- array(NA_real_, dim = c(n_sim, p, n_methods),
                          dimnames = list(NULL, paste0("X", 1:p), method_names))

    # Data-splitting approach: select on first half, refit on second half
    ds_selected_arr <- array(FALSE,    dim = c(n_sim, p, n_methods),
                             dimnames = list(NULL, paste0("X", 1:p), method_names))
    ds_beta_hat_arr <- array(0,        dim = c(n_sim, p, n_methods),
                             dimnames = list(NULL, paste0("X", 1:p), method_names))
    ds_ci_lower_arr <- array(NA_real_, dim = c(n_sim, p, n_methods),
                             dimnames = list(NULL, paste0("X", 1:p), method_names))
    ds_ci_upper_arr <- array(NA_real_, dim = c(n_sim, p, n_methods),
                             dimnames = list(NULL, paste0("X", 1:p), method_names))
    ds_pval_arr     <- array(NA_real_, dim = c(n_sim, p, n_methods),
                             dimnames = list(NULL, paste0("X", 1:p), method_names))

    for (sim in 1:n_sim) {

      if (sim %% 100 == 0) message("  Replicate ", sim, " / ", n_sim)

      # --- Generate data ---
      dat   <- generate_data(n = N, p = p, betas = all_betas, rho = rho)
      X_mat <- as.matrix(dat[, -1])
      Y_vec <- dat$Y

      # --- Data split indices ---
      half   <- floor(N / 2)
      idx1   <- 1:half
      idx2   <- (half + 1):N
      dat1   <- dat[idx1, ]
      dat2   <- dat[idx2, ]
      X_mat1 <- X_mat[idx1, ]
      Y_vec1 <- Y_vec[idx1]

      # ---- Apply each selection method ----

      # 1. Backward F-test
      sel <- backward_f_select(dat)
      selected_arr[sim, , "Backward_F"] <- sel
      refit <- refit_ols(dat, sel)
      beta_hat_arr[sim, , "Backward_F"] <- refit$beta_hat
      ci_lower_arr[sim, , "Backward_F"] <- refit$ci_lower
      ci_upper_arr[sim, , "Backward_F"] <- refit$ci_upper
      pval_arr[sim, , "Backward_F"]     <- refit$pvals

      sel_ds <- backward_f_select(dat1)
      ds_selected_arr[sim, , "Backward_F"] <- sel_ds
      refit_ds <- refit_ols(dat2, sel_ds)
      ds_beta_hat_arr[sim, , "Backward_F"] <- refit_ds$beta_hat
      ds_ci_lower_arr[sim, , "Backward_F"] <- refit_ds$ci_lower
      ds_ci_upper_arr[sim, , "Backward_F"] <- refit_ds$ci_upper
      ds_pval_arr[sim, , "Backward_F"]     <- refit_ds$pvals

      # 2. AIC
      sel <- aic_select(dat)
      selected_arr[sim, , "AIC"] <- sel
      refit <- refit_ols(dat, sel)
      beta_hat_arr[sim, , "AIC"] <- refit$beta_hat
      ci_lower_arr[sim, , "AIC"] <- refit$ci_lower
      ci_upper_arr[sim, , "AIC"] <- refit$ci_upper
      pval_arr[sim, , "AIC"]     <- refit$pvals

      sel_ds <- aic_select(dat1)
      ds_selected_arr[sim, , "AIC"] <- sel_ds
      refit_ds <- refit_ols(dat2, sel_ds)
      ds_beta_hat_arr[sim, , "AIC"] <- refit_ds$beta_hat
      ds_ci_lower_arr[sim, , "AIC"] <- refit_ds$ci_lower
      ds_ci_upper_arr[sim, , "AIC"] <- refit_ds$ci_upper
      ds_pval_arr[sim, , "AIC"]     <- refit_ds$pvals

      # 3. BIC
      sel <- bic_select(dat)
      selected_arr[sim, , "BIC"] <- sel
      refit <- refit_ols(dat, sel)
      beta_hat_arr[sim, , "BIC"] <- refit$beta_hat
      ci_lower_arr[sim, , "BIC"] <- refit$ci_lower
      ci_upper_arr[sim, , "BIC"] <- refit$ci_upper
      pval_arr[sim, , "BIC"]     <- refit$pvals

      sel_ds <- bic_select(dat1)
      ds_selected_arr[sim, , "BIC"] <- sel_ds
      refit_ds <- refit_ols(dat2, sel_ds)
      ds_beta_hat_arr[sim, , "BIC"] <- refit_ds$beta_hat
      ds_ci_lower_arr[sim, , "BIC"] <- refit_ds$ci_lower
      ds_ci_upper_arr[sim, , "BIC"] <- refit_ds$ci_upper
      ds_pval_arr[sim, , "BIC"]     <- refit_ds$pvals

      # 4. Lasso - lambda.min
      sel <- penalized_select(X_mat, Y_vec, alpha_val = 1, lambda_rule = "min")
      selected_arr[sim, , "Lasso_min"] <- sel
      refit <- refit_ols(dat, sel)
      beta_hat_arr[sim, , "Lasso_min"] <- refit$beta_hat
      ci_lower_arr[sim, , "Lasso_min"] <- refit$ci_lower
      ci_upper_arr[sim, , "Lasso_min"] <- refit$ci_upper
      pval_arr[sim, , "Lasso_min"]     <- refit$pvals

      sel_ds <- penalized_select(X_mat1, Y_vec1, alpha_val = 1, lambda_rule = "min")
      ds_selected_arr[sim, , "Lasso_min"] <- sel_ds
      refit_ds <- refit_ols(dat2, sel_ds)
      ds_beta_hat_arr[sim, , "Lasso_min"] <- refit_ds$beta_hat
      ds_ci_lower_arr[sim, , "Lasso_min"] <- refit_ds$ci_lower
      ds_ci_upper_arr[sim, , "Lasso_min"] <- refit_ds$ci_upper
      ds_pval_arr[sim, , "Lasso_min"]     <- refit_ds$pvals

      # 5. Lasso - lambda.1se
      sel <- penalized_select(X_mat, Y_vec, alpha_val = 1, lambda_rule = "1se")
      selected_arr[sim, , "Lasso_1se"] <- sel
      refit <- refit_ols(dat, sel)
      beta_hat_arr[sim, , "Lasso_1se"] <- refit$beta_hat
      ci_lower_arr[sim, , "Lasso_1se"] <- refit$ci_lower
      ci_upper_arr[sim, , "Lasso_1se"] <- refit$ci_upper
      pval_arr[sim, , "Lasso_1se"]     <- refit$pvals

      sel_ds <- penalized_select(X_mat1, Y_vec1, alpha_val = 1, lambda_rule = "1se")
      ds_selected_arr[sim, , "Lasso_1se"] <- sel_ds
      refit_ds <- refit_ols(dat2, sel_ds)
      ds_beta_hat_arr[sim, , "Lasso_1se"] <- refit_ds$beta_hat
      ds_ci_lower_arr[sim, , "Lasso_1se"] <- refit_ds$ci_lower
      ds_ci_upper_arr[sim, , "Lasso_1se"] <- refit_ds$ci_upper
      ds_pval_arr[sim, , "Lasso_1se"]     <- refit_ds$pvals

      # 6. Elastic net - lambda.min
      sel <- penalized_select(X_mat, Y_vec, alpha_val = 0.5, lambda_rule = "min")
      selected_arr[sim, , "ENet_min"] <- sel
      refit <- refit_ols(dat, sel)
      beta_hat_arr[sim, , "ENet_min"] <- refit$beta_hat
      ci_lower_arr[sim, , "ENet_min"] <- refit$ci_lower
      ci_upper_arr[sim, , "ENet_min"] <- refit$ci_upper
      pval_arr[sim, , "ENet_min"]     <- refit$pvals

      sel_ds <- penalized_select(X_mat1, Y_vec1, alpha_val = 0.5, lambda_rule = "min")
      ds_selected_arr[sim, , "ENet_min"] <- sel_ds
      refit_ds <- refit_ols(dat2, sel_ds)
      ds_beta_hat_arr[sim, , "ENet_min"] <- refit_ds$beta_hat
      ds_ci_lower_arr[sim, , "ENet_min"] <- refit_ds$ci_lower
      ds_ci_upper_arr[sim, , "ENet_min"] <- refit_ds$ci_upper
      ds_pval_arr[sim, , "ENet_min"]     <- refit_ds$pvals

      # 7. Elastic net - lambda.1se
      sel <- penalized_select(X_mat, Y_vec, alpha_val = 0.5, lambda_rule = "1se")
      selected_arr[sim, , "ENet_1se"] <- sel
      refit <- refit_ols(dat, sel)
      beta_hat_arr[sim, , "ENet_1se"] <- refit$beta_hat
      ci_lower_arr[sim, , "ENet_1se"] <- refit$ci_lower
      ci_upper_arr[sim, , "ENet_1se"] <- refit$ci_upper
      pval_arr[sim, , "ENet_1se"]     <- refit$pvals

      sel_ds <- penalized_select(X_mat1, Y_vec1, alpha_val = 0.5, lambda_rule = "1se")
      ds_selected_arr[sim, , "ENet_1se"] <- sel_ds
      refit_ds <- refit_ols(dat2, sel_ds)
      ds_beta_hat_arr[sim, , "ENet_1se"] <- refit_ds$beta_hat
      ds_ci_lower_arr[sim, , "ENet_1se"] <- refit_ds$ci_lower
      ds_ci_upper_arr[sim, , "ENet_1se"] <- refit_ds$ci_upper
      ds_pval_arr[sim, , "ENet_1se"]     <- refit_ds$pvals

    } # end sim loop

    # --- Store results for this scenario ---
    results_all[[scenario_name]] <- list(
      N    = N,
      rho  = rho,
      # Naive
      selected = selected_arr,
      beta_hat = beta_hat_arr,
      ci_lower = ci_lower_arr,
      ci_upper = ci_upper_arr,
      pvals    = pval_arr,
      # Data splitting
      ds_selected = ds_selected_arr,
      ds_beta_hat = ds_beta_hat_arr,
      ds_ci_lower = ds_ci_lower_arr,
      ds_ci_upper = ds_ci_upper_arr,
      ds_pvals    = ds_pval_arr
    )

    message("Finished scenario: ", scenario_name)

  } # end rho loop
} # end N loop


# ============================================================
# SECTION 4: COMPUTE PERFORMANCE METRICS
# ============================================================

compute_metrics <- function(res, all_betas, true_idx, null_idx) {

  n_methods <- dim(res$selected)[3]
  mnames    <- dimnames(res$selected)[[3]]
  var_names <- paste0("X", 1:20)

  # --- Container for summary ---
  metric_list <- list()

  for (m in 1:n_methods) {

    mname <- mnames[m]

    # --- Extract arrays for this method ---
    sel   <- res$selected[, , m]      # n_sim x p logical
    bhat  <- res$beta_hat[, , m]      # n_sim x p
    cil   <- res$ci_lower[, , m]
    ciu   <- res$ci_upper[, , m]
    pvs   <- res$pvals[, , m]

    ds_sel  <- res$ds_selected[, , m]
    ds_bhat <- res$ds_beta_hat[, , m]
    ds_cil  <- res$ds_ci_lower[, , m]
    ds_ciu  <- res$ds_ci_upper[, , m]
    ds_pvs  <- res$ds_pvals[, , m]

    # ---- Selection rates ----
    selection_rate <- colMeans(sel)
    ds_selection_rate <- colMeans(ds_sel)

    # ---- True positive rate (per true variable) ----
    tpr     <- selection_rate[true_idx]
    ds_tpr  <- ds_selection_rate[true_idx]

    # ---- False positive rate (per null variable and average) ----
    fpr         <- selection_rate[null_idx]
    fpr_avg     <- mean(fpr)
    ds_fpr      <- ds_selection_rate[null_idx]
    ds_fpr_avg  <- mean(ds_fpr)

    # ---- Bias (unconditional: non-selected = 0) ----
    bias <- colMeans(bhat) - all_betas
    ds_bias <- colMeans(ds_bhat) - all_betas

    # ---- 95% CI coverage ----
    # For selected variables: check if CI contains the true beta
    # For non-selected true predictors: non-coverage (true beta != 0)
    # For non-selected null predictors: coverage (true beta = 0, est = 0)
    coverage <- rep(NA_real_, 20)
    ds_coverage <- rep(NA_real_, 20)
    names(coverage) <- names(ds_coverage) <- var_names

    for (j in 1:20) {
      # Naive
      covers_j <- rep(FALSE, nrow(sel))
      sel_j    <- sel[, j]

      # When selected: check CI
      if (any(sel_j)) {
        covers_j[sel_j] <- (cil[sel_j, j] <= all_betas[j]) &
                            (ciu[sel_j, j] >= all_betas[j])
      }
      # When not selected:
      #   true predictor (beta != 0) -> non-coverage (FALSE, already default)
      #   null predictor (beta == 0) -> coverage (TRUE)
      if (j %in% null_idx) {
        covers_j[!sel_j] <- TRUE
      }
      coverage[j] <- mean(covers_j)

      # Data splitting
      ds_covers_j <- rep(FALSE, nrow(ds_sel))
      ds_sel_j    <- ds_sel[, j]
      if (any(ds_sel_j)) {
        ds_covers_j[ds_sel_j] <- (ds_cil[ds_sel_j, j] <= all_betas[j]) &
                                  (ds_ciu[ds_sel_j, j] >= all_betas[j])
      }
      if (j %in% null_idx) {
        ds_covers_j[!ds_sel_j] <- TRUE
      }
      ds_coverage[j] <- mean(ds_covers_j)
    }

    # ---- Type I error (null predictors) ----
    # A null predictor contributes a Type I error if it is selected
    # AND has p < 0.05 in the refit model.
    # Non-selection of a null predictor = correct decision (no error).
    type1 <- rep(NA_real_, length(null_idx))
    ds_type1 <- rep(NA_real_, length(null_idx))
    names(type1) <- names(ds_type1) <- var_names[null_idx]

    for (k in seq_along(null_idx)) {
      j <- null_idx[k]
      # Naive
      sig_j <- rep(FALSE, nrow(sel))
      sel_j <- sel[, j]
      if (any(sel_j)) {
        sig_j[sel_j] <- pvs[sel_j, j] < 0.05
      }
      type1[k] <- mean(sig_j)

      # Data splitting
      ds_sig_j <- rep(FALSE, nrow(ds_sel))
      ds_sel_j <- ds_sel[, j]
      if (any(ds_sel_j)) {
        ds_sig_j[ds_sel_j] <- ds_pvs[ds_sel_j, j] < 0.05
      }
      ds_type1[k] <- mean(ds_sig_j)
    }

    # ---- Type II error (true predictors) ----
    # A true predictor contributes a Type II error if it is NOT selected
    # OR if selected but NOT significant (p >= 0.05) in the refit model.
    type2 <- rep(NA_real_, length(true_idx))
    ds_type2 <- rep(NA_real_, length(true_idx))
    names(type2) <- names(ds_type2) <- var_names[true_idx]

    for (k in seq_along(true_idx)) {
      j <- true_idx[k]
      # Naive
      error_j <- rep(TRUE, nrow(sel))   # default: error
      sel_j   <- sel[, j]
      if (any(sel_j)) {
        error_j[sel_j] <- pvs[sel_j, j] >= 0.05
      }
      type2[k] <- mean(error_j)

      # Data splitting
      ds_error_j <- rep(TRUE, nrow(ds_sel))
      ds_sel_j   <- ds_sel[, j]
      if (any(ds_sel_j)) {
        ds_error_j[ds_sel_j] <- ds_pvs[ds_sel_j, j] >= 0.05
      }
      ds_type2[k] <- mean(ds_error_j)
    }

    # ---- Store ----
    metric_list[[mname]] <- list(
      # Selection
      tpr          = tpr,
      fpr          = fpr,
      fpr_avg      = fpr_avg,
      # Naive inference
      bias         = bias,
      coverage     = coverage,
      type1        = type1,
      type1_avg    = mean(type1),
      type2        = type2,
      # Data-splitting inference
      ds_tpr       = ds_tpr,
      ds_fpr       = ds_fpr,
      ds_fpr_avg   = ds_fpr_avg,
      ds_bias      = ds_bias,
      ds_coverage  = ds_coverage,
      ds_type1     = ds_type1,
      ds_type1_avg = mean(ds_type1),
      ds_type2     = ds_type2
    )

  } # end method loop

  return(metric_list)
}


# --- Apply to all scenarios ---
metrics_all <- list()
for (sc in names(results_all)) {
  message("Computing metrics for: ", sc)
  metrics_all[[sc]] <- compute_metrics(results_all[[sc]],
                                        all_betas, true_idx, null_idx)
}


# ============================================================
# SECTION 5: BUILD SUMMARY TABLES
# ============================================================

# --- 5a. True positive rate table (per true variable, per method) ---
build_tpr_table <- function(metrics_all, inference = "naive") {

  scenarios <- names(metrics_all)
  rows <- list()

  for (sc in scenarios) {
    for (mname in names(metrics_all[[sc]])) {
      m <- metrics_all[[sc]][[mname]]
      tpr_vals <- if (inference == "naive") m$tpr else m$ds_tpr
      row <- data.frame(
        Scenario = sc,
        Method   = mname,
        X1 = tpr_vals[1],
        X2 = tpr_vals[2],
        X3 = tpr_vals[3],
        X4 = tpr_vals[4],
        X5 = tpr_vals[5],
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- row
    }
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

# --- 5b. False positive rate table (average over X6-X20) ---
build_fpr_table <- function(metrics_all, inference = "naive") {

  scenarios <- names(metrics_all)
  rows <- list()

  for (sc in scenarios) {
    for (mname in names(metrics_all[[sc]])) {
      m <- metrics_all[[sc]][[mname]]
      fpr_val <- if (inference == "naive") m$fpr_avg else m$ds_fpr_avg
      row <- data.frame(
        Scenario = sc,
        Method   = mname,
        FPR_avg  = fpr_val,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- row
    }
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

# --- 5c. Bias table (per true variable) ---
build_bias_table <- function(metrics_all, inference = "naive") {

  scenarios <- names(metrics_all)
  rows <- list()

  for (sc in scenarios) {
    for (mname in names(metrics_all[[sc]])) {
      m <- metrics_all[[sc]][[mname]]
      b <- if (inference == "naive") m$bias else m$ds_bias
      row <- data.frame(
        Scenario = sc,
        Method   = mname,
        X1 = round(b[1], 4),
        X2 = round(b[2], 4),
        X3 = round(b[3], 4),
        X4 = round(b[4], 4),
        X5 = round(b[5], 4),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- row
    }
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

# --- 5d. Coverage table (per true variable) ---
build_coverage_table <- function(metrics_all, inference = "naive") {

  scenarios <- names(metrics_all)
  rows <- list()

  for (sc in scenarios) {
    for (mname in names(metrics_all[[sc]])) {
      m <- metrics_all[[sc]][[mname]]
      cov_vals <- if (inference == "naive") m$coverage else m$ds_coverage
      row <- data.frame(
        Scenario = sc,
        Method   = mname,
        X1 = cov_vals[1],
        X2 = cov_vals[2],
        X3 = cov_vals[3],
        X4 = cov_vals[4],
        X5 = cov_vals[5],
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- row
    }
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

# --- 5e. Type I error table (average over null variables) ---
build_type1_table <- function(metrics_all, inference = "naive") {

  scenarios <- names(metrics_all)
  rows <- list()

  for (sc in scenarios) {
    for (mname in names(metrics_all[[sc]])) {
      m <- metrics_all[[sc]][[mname]]
      t1 <- if (inference == "naive") m$type1_avg else m$ds_type1_avg
      row <- data.frame(
        Scenario = sc,
        Method   = mname,
        Type1_avg = t1,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- row
    }
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

# --- 5f. Type II error table (per true variable) ---
build_type2_table <- function(metrics_all, inference = "naive") {

  scenarios <- names(metrics_all)
  rows <- list()

  for (sc in scenarios) {
    for (mname in names(metrics_all[[sc]])) {
      m <- metrics_all[[sc]][[mname]]
      t2 <- if (inference == "naive") m$type2 else m$ds_type2
      row <- data.frame(
        Scenario = sc,
        Method   = mname,
        X1 = t2[1],
        X2 = t2[2],
        X3 = t2[3],
        X4 = t2[4],
        X5 = t2[5],
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- row
    }
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}


# --- Generate all summary tables ---
tpr_naive     <- build_tpr_table(metrics_all, "naive")
tpr_ds        <- build_tpr_table(metrics_all, "ds")

fpr_naive     <- build_fpr_table(metrics_all, "naive")
fpr_ds        <- build_fpr_table(metrics_all, "ds")

bias_naive    <- build_bias_table(metrics_all, "naive")
bias_ds       <- build_bias_table(metrics_all, "ds")

cov_naive     <- build_coverage_table(metrics_all, "naive")
cov_ds        <- build_coverage_table(metrics_all, "ds")

type1_naive   <- build_type1_table(metrics_all, "naive")
type1_ds      <- build_type1_table(metrics_all, "ds")

type2_naive   <- build_type2_table(metrics_all, "naive")
type2_ds      <- build_type2_table(metrics_all, "ds")

# --- Print summary tables ---
message("\n=== TRUE POSITIVE RATES (Naive) ===")
print(tpr_naive, row.names = FALSE)

message("\n=== FALSE POSITIVE RATES (Naive) ===")
print(fpr_naive, row.names = FALSE)

message("\n=== BIAS (Naive) ===")
print(bias_naive, row.names = FALSE)

message("\n=== 95% CI COVERAGE (Naive) ===")
print(cov_naive, row.names = FALSE)

message("\n=== TYPE I ERROR (Naive) ===")
print(type1_naive, row.names = FALSE)

message("\n=== TYPE II ERROR (Naive) ===")
print(type2_naive, row.names = FALSE)

message("\n=== TRUE POSITIVE RATES (Data Splitting) ===")
print(tpr_ds, row.names = FALSE)

message("\n=== 95% CI COVERAGE (Data Splitting) ===")
print(cov_ds, row.names = FALSE)

message("\n=== TYPE I ERROR (Data Splitting) ===")
print(type1_ds, row.names = FALSE)

message("\n=== TYPE II ERROR (Data Splitting) ===")
print(type2_ds, row.names = FALSE)


# ============================================================
# SECTION 6: SAVE RESULTS
# ============================================================

save(results_all, metrics_all,
     tpr_naive, tpr_ds,
     fpr_naive, fpr_ds,
     bias_naive, bias_ds,
     cov_naive, cov_ds,
     type1_naive, type1_ds,
     type2_naive, type2_ds,
     file = "simulation_results.RData")

message("All results saved to simulation_results.RData")
```
